what: CI enforcement is wired through local make lint, but CI runs make lint-only plus separate harness shards
scenario_or_breakage: The foreground marker lint can be absent from CI while the plan claims CI/pre-commit coverage; marker drift could merge green
suggested_fix: Add a pre-commit hook or dedicated CI step/job for scripts/lint-foreground-markers.sh; also add test-lint-foreground-markers to .PHONY and exactly one test-harnesses-N shard

what: The linter scan globs exclude skills/shared/*.md even though the plan modifies and relies on shared protocol files
scenario_or_breakage: Fenced collect-agent-results.sh sites in shared protocols remain unscanned, so future foreground-marker drift is not enforced
suggested_fix: Include skills/shared/*.md in the linter walker and add a fixture proving shared docs are scanned

what: The planned leading-command detector can miss command-substitution invocations assigned to variables
scenario_or_breakage: dispatch-with-waterfall.sh and dispatch-plan-voters.sh are invoked as _var=$(".../script.sh" ...), so a command-start-only matcher may not require markers
suggested_fix: Add parser support and fixtures for optional assignments and command substitutions containing quoted ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/<basename>.sh invocations

what: The file inventory points dispatch-plan-voters marker work at skills/design/SKILL.md, but the fenced calls live in plan-review.md
scenario_or_breakage: Implementer may edit the wrong surface or omit plan-review.md, causing lint failure or unmarked blocking call docs
suggested_fix: Add skills/design/references/plan-review.md explicitly to the modified-file list for both collect-agent-results.sh and dispatch-plan-voters.sh blocks

what: New lint target and linter contract are not planned for docs/linting.md
scenario_or_breakage: Canonical lint documentation drifts from Makefile and contributors may not discover the target or CI/local split
suggested_fix: Update docs/linting.md with the foreground-marker linter and make target, including whether it is local, pre-commit, CI, and/or harness-shard enforced
